aguṇena ca tṛtīyakṣaṇe svayam eva naṅkṣyatīti taddhānārthaḥ prayāso viphala
ity arthaḥ / (-) Asmāc ca sūtrād ātyantikī duḥkhanivṛttir eva mokṣa iti siddham / Asmin sūtre
